messages:
customer-olivia: Hey team — seeing very choppy streaming in prod (EU region) for long chat responses. Tokens arrive in tiny bursts then stop before the final ~150–300 tokens. Happens ~50% of attempts since 08:50 UTC. Request IDs: req_4f3b2a, req_4f3b8c. Using EventSource polyfill in our SPA. Can share logs and a curl repro if helpful.

support_john: thanks — can you paste a short client log snippet and try a raw curl against the API so we can rule out the polyfill? also which model + route are you hitting? any proxy (cloudfront/nginx) in front of the client?

customer-olivia: client logs (trimmed):
```
[2026-03-17T08:51:03Z] SSE: open
[2026-03-17T08:51:04Z] SSE: event:data chunk (len=32)
[2026-03-17T08:51:04Z] SSE: event:data chunk (len=10)
[2026-03-17T08:51:07Z] SSE: connection dropped, reconnecting
[2026-03-17T08:51:07Z] SSE: last event id: 
```
We do have CloudFront in front of our CDN + a small nginx on origin. Model: redwood/gpt-12k (hosted). Route: /v1/chat/stream

support_john: please run this curl from a machine with the same network path (replace $KEY and $MODEL):
```
curl -v -N \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat/stream?model=$MODEL \
  -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"long prompt to get ~800 tokens"}]}'
```
Add `--no-buffer` on mac to avoid curl buffering. Paste full curl response (headers + body).

eng-ryan: tagging infra folks — tiny/stuttery chunks + early termination usually = proxy/nginx buffering or keepalive timeout. Can you also check nginx config for `proxy_buffering on/off`, `proxy_request_buffering`, and `.conf` for `proxy_read_timeout`? CloudFront also has idle timeout (~30s) and may close if there are pauses in token emission.

alex: quick network checklist: 1) confirm no intermediate HTTP/2->HTTP/1 proxy doing coalescing; 2) check if gzip is enabled on proxy (can change chunk sizes); 3) capture a HAR or tcpdump for one failing request.

devex-maria: one more ask — can you run a websocket test to compare? our websocket path is `/v1/chat/ws` — if WS completes reliably, it points at HTTP proxies. If WS also fails, then runtime might be trimming final tokens.

customer-olivia: ran curl from a EU VM, output below (headers redacted):
```
> GET /v1/chat/stream?model=redwood/gpt-12k HTTP/1.1
< HTTP/1.1 200 OK
< content-type: text/event-stream
< request-id: req_4f3b2a

data: {"delta":"Hello"}

data: {"delta":" world"}

[...quiet for 6s...]

# then connection closed with FIN, no more data
```
When we switch client to websocket the whole payload comes through every time.

sre-bot: infra-check: no infra deploys in EU region at 08:45–08:55 UTC. No autoscaler events. CDN edge logs show some 502s but not for these request IDs.

support_john: thanks — that curl result is super helpful. Next steps please:
- customer: please run tcpdump/pcap on the origin/NAT path during a failing run and upload to the debug bucket (see instructions below).
- customer: generate debug bundle (browser HAR + client console logs + request-id) and share link.
- eng-ryan/infra: can you look at CloudFront->nginx timeouts and buffering knobs for these request-ids? specifically check `proxy_buffering` and whether `chunked_transfer_encoding` is being modified.

devex-maria: repro command for websocket test:
```
# using wscat
wscat -c "wss://api.redwood.example/v1/chat/ws?model=redwood/gpt-12k" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -x '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"long prompt..."}]}'
```
If WS completes while SSE doesn't, prioritize proxy buffering investigation.

customer-olivia: uploaded debug bundle: https://internal-debug.s3/olivia/req_4f3b2a-pcap-har.zip
Also ran tcpdump and attached. In the pcap I can see TCP FIN from CloudFront side right after a pause.

support_john: OK elevating to eng-runtime and infra. Escalation notes:
- symptom: SSE streams deliver initial small chunks then pause; final ~150–300 tokens missing; WS succeeds
- evidence: curl -N reproduction, pcap showing FIN from CloudFront edge after pause, request-ids: req_4f3b2a, req_4f3b8c
- customer debug bundle: https://internal-debug.s3/olivia/req_4f3b2a-pcap-har.zip

eng-ryan: thanks — I'll pull CloudFront edge logs for those request-ids and check origin NGX settings. If we need to reproduce internally, I'll run curl behind a simulated CDN with `proxy_buffering on` to try to trigger the close.

support_john: will keep thread open and post updates. @alex @devex-maria will follow for fixes and mitigation steps. :mag:
